item.title: Sample: Scale-dependent bias constraints on $f_{\rm NL}^{\rm local}$ from a quasar sample
item.description: arXiv:2699.90001v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sample abstract for testing. We measure the large-scale power spectrum of a quasar sample and constrain local primordial non-Gaussianity through the scale-dependent bias. Marginalising over the response $b_\phi$, we obtain $f_{\rm NL}^{\rm local} = 2 \pm 9$ (68%). Imaging systematics are mitigated with a neural-network weighting scheme.
item.dc:creator: A. Sample, B. Placeholder, C. Example

item.title: Sample: Parity-odd four-point function of luminous red galaxies with simulation-based covariance
item.description: arXiv:2699.90002v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sample abstract for testing. We estimate the parity-odd part of the galaxy four-point correlation function using an isotropic basis and a covariance from 4000 mocks. We find no evidence for parity violation once the covariance is estimated from simulations rather than analytically.
item.dc:creator: D. Testcase, E. Mockingbird

item.title: Sample: Bars & spirals in Milky Way analogues at $z<0.1$
item.description: arXiv:2699.90003v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sample abstract for testing. Using integral-field spectroscopy of 300 disc galaxies we show that strong bars quench the central star formation rate by a factor of two relative to unbarred discs at fixed stellar mass.
item.dc:creator: F. Ångström-Dummy, G. Example

item.title: Sample: Chiral gravitational waves from axion-gauge field dynamics
item.description: arXiv:2699.90004v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sample abstract for testing. A rolling axion coupled to an SU(2) gauge field sources circularly polarised tensor modes. We compute the resulting TB and EB spectra and forecast detectability with a LiteBIRD-like mission.
item.dc:creator: H. Sample, I. Placeholder

item.title: Sample: Quasinormal modes of rotating black holes in modified gravity
item.description: arXiv:2699.90005v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sample abstract for testing. We compute the quasinormal mode spectrum of slowly rotating black holes in a scalar-Gauss-Bonnet theory and quantify deviations from the Kerr spectrum.

item.title: Sample: Cross-listed note on cosmic birefringence from string axiverse
item.description: arXiv:2699.90006v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Sample abstract for testing. Axion-like fields from string compactifications rotate the CMB polarisation plane; we relate the isotropic birefringence angle to the axion decay constant.

item.title: Sample: Satellite galaxies as tracers of halo assembly
item.description: arXiv:2699.90007v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sample abstract for testing. Satellite abundances in hydrodynamical simulations correlate with halo formation time at fixed mass, offering an observable proxy for assembly bias.
